In the About page (frontend/src/app/about/about.component.ts:119) the raw feedback comment is embedded in an HTML string, so a feedback comment with script-bearing markup submitted via the feedback API executes in every visitor's browser and can read the localStorage JWT. In frontend/src/app/administration/administration.component.ts:91 feedback comments are trusted in the admin table and details dialog (and the about gallery), so the payload runs for admins and can steal the admin token. In frontend/src/app/search-result/search-result.component.ts:143 the q query parameter is passed to bypassSecurityTrustHtml, so a crafted search link runs script in the victim's origin and can steal the JWT and cookie. In frontend/src/app/track-result/track-result.component.ts:48 the orderId from the track-order API is wrapped in a code tag and trusted; if an attacker controls the stored or echoed value, script runs in the viewer's browser. The finding holds further places beyond those cited (location_count is 5). g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access Any logged-in user can act on other users' objects because ids are not tied to the caller. server.ts:450: PUT /api/Addresss/:id runs only appendUserId and the generated update handler modifies the address by id. routes/basket.ts:19: GET /rest/basket/:id passes isAuthorized but findOne uses only the path id; the bid comparison occurs only inside a challenge callback. routes/coupon.ts:18: PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon updates the basket by path id without comparing it to the caller's basket. routes/order.ts:35: POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout loads the basket by id only and completes the order, consuming the victim's items; internals of isAuthorized and appendUserId were not served, so any basket binding is unverified. server.ts:426: PUT /api/BasketItems/:id and server.ts:603: GET /rest/basket/:id load a resource by request-supplied id with authentication but no ownership predicate. The finding holds further places beyond those cited (location_count is 8). C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-007) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters Send GET /rest/products/search with q set to a payload that closes the LIKE string. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Username evaluated as server-side code Log in and POST /profile with username set to #{...} containing Node code. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication A predictable token/secret lets an attacker guess or brute-force session identifiers, reset links, or OTPs. C-09 · Authentication & Session Surface Regular account required Security-sensitive data uses weak cryptographic primitives (W-044) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets The unauthenticated /file-upload route extracts zip entries to 'uploads/complaints/'+entry.path (routes/fileUpload.ts:34). The check only tests that the resolved path contains the working directory, so entries like ../../ftp/legal.md write or overwrite files inside the application tree. No file type is enforced and extraction size is unbounded. Controls: a 200KB multer memory limit (route wiring not served). C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers Several frontend components mark untrusted data as trusted HTML and bind it to innerHTML. In the About page (frontend/src/app/about/about.component.ts:119) the raw feedback comment is embedded in an HTML string, so a feedback comment with script-bearing markup submitted via the feedback API executes in every visitor's browser and can read the localStorage JWT. In frontend/src/app/administration/administration.component.ts:91 feedback comments are trusted in the admin table and details dialog (and the about gallery), so the payload runs for admins and can steal the admin token. In frontend/src/app/search-result/search-result.component.ts:143 the q query parameter is passed to bypassSecurityTrustHtml, so a crafted search link runs script in the victim's origin and can steal the JWT and cookie. In frontend/src/app/track-result/track-result.component.ts:48 the orderId from the track-order API is wrapped in a code tag and trusted; if an attacker controls the stored or echoed value, script runs in the viewer's browser. The finding holds further places beyond those cited (location_count is 5). Server-side sanitization of POST /api/Feedbacks was not served. C-05 · Angular Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-010) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data
